class="markdown-body" data-turbolinks="false"><div class="markdown-body safe-html-box__Uwc6Al"><p dir="auto">I added some debug logging.</p>
<p dir="auto">The <code class="notranslate">checkSameSiteNoneCompatible()</code> method in <code class="notranslate">CookieHelper.php</code> is returning <code class="notranslate">true</code>.</p>
<p dir="auto">The redirect back to login happens in <code class="notranslate">AuthController.php</code> because <code class="notranslate">$status</code> is null returning from <code class="notranslate">AuthenticateShop::__invoke()</code> because the call to <code class="notranslate">$this->apiHelper->verifyRequest</code> is returning false.</p>
<p dir="auto">The <code class="notranslate">Request</code> object seems valid in that it has a shop, a timestamp and an hmac (plus a code which doesn't seem to be used in verifyRequest).  However, the params also contain <code class="notranslate">"q":"/authenticate"</code> ... removing that from the params (           <code class="notranslate">unset($params['q']);</code>) before computing the hmac hash allows it to work correctly and redirect to the shopify store after authentication.</p>
<p dir="auto">After redirection, I see the app loaded correctly in the shopify admin interface.</p>
<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/249841/88070737-0414b480-cb41-11ea-84f1-86a4e8a27fc7.png"><img src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/249841/88070737-0414b480-cb41-11ea-84f1-86a4e8a27fc7.png" alt="image" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<p dir="auto">However, in the Apps list, I still see this after a fresh install of the app.</p>
<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/249841/88070797-155dc100-cb41-11ea-9195-14333a4796a5.png"><img src="https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/249841/88070797-155dc100-cb41-11ea-9195-14333a4796a5.png" alt="image" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<p dir="auto">I would recommend changing <code class="notranslate">verifyRequest</code> to only include keys from <code class="notranslate">$params</code> that should be in the hmac hash calculation, data-turbolinks="false"><div class="markdown-body safe-html-box__Uwc6Al"><p dir="auto">I've had some success now by probing the Koa implementation.</p>
<p dir="auto">I believe my flow needs to be this:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>ITP middleware will check for ITP cookie</li>
<li>If ITP cookie does not exist, redirect to top level and set a same site cookie, then redirect back to app with a query param of ?itp=true</li>
<li>Once redirected back to app, it'll run through ITP middleware again, we will check for ITP cookie, if it doesn't exist and the ITP query param exists, then we need to redirect to a cookie/storage permission page</li>
<li>On this page, using JS, user will read a prompt and click to try and enable cookies / storage access</li>
<li>Some browsers will prompt to confirm, others just allow it</li>
<li>Once this is done, were good to redirect back and have cookie access</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">With this plan in mind and loosely working I'll continue to develop a solution.</p></div></div><div role="toolbar" aria-label="Reactions" class="d-flex gap-1 flex-wrap"><div
